name: Sodarace walker program evolution
description: Write a Python make_walker() that builds a valid Sodarace walker (point masses and oscillating springs) with the evaluator's walker_creator; scored by the absolute horizontal displacement of its centre of mass after 28 s of simulated time on flat ground in the vendored OpenELM Box2D simulator (higher is better).

sources.locator: simulator.py, helpers.py and walker/walk_creator.py (MIT), vendored in sim_control_sodarace_sim.py; walker/*.py seed walkers used for the cross-check
Physics/IESoR/Simulation/iesorWorld.cpp and iesorWorld.h: the C++ simulator OpenELM translates (Muscle constructor, addMuscleJoint, updateWorld)

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

evaluation.paper_metric: horizontal displacement of the simulated walker

notes: Original models and full training pipeline are not linked as an official repository in the paper. OpenELM is a separate related implementation.

limitations: No official runnable repository was verified from the paper/project sources examined.
Upstream commands and dependencies were inspected; costly training, paid APIs, and hardware experiments were not executed.
No publicly accessible, paper-linked implementation with a verified immutable revision was established.
